title: Naming the squares
line: Files a to h, ranks 1 to 8: every square has a name, from a1 to h8.

steps.text: The columns of the board are called files, a to h from White's left. The rows are called ranks, 1 to 8 from White's side.
A square is named by its file, then its rank. The white king starts on e1, the black king on e8.

wrong.d4: That is d4, one file to the left.
wrong.e5: That is e5, one rank higher.
wrong.e3: That is e3, one rank lower.

wrong.e5: That is e5, one file to the right.
wrong.d4: That is d4, one rank lower.

steps.text: Tap the square where the black queen starts.

wrong.e8: That is e8, the black king's square.
wrong.d1: That is d1, where the white queen starts.

steps.after: The black queen starts on d8, straight across from the white queen on d1.

steps.text: Move the knight from g1 to f3.

wrong.f2f3: That moves the pawn from f2. Move the knight from g1 to f3.

steps.after: Black answered by moving a pawn from d7 to d5.

steps.text: Now move the pawn from d2 to d4.
steps.after: The two pawns now face each other, on d4 and d5.

summary: Files run a to h, ranks 1 to 8. A square is its file, then its rank: e4, d5, h8.
